title: District Empirical Observations: Katni & Indore
description: Granular field observations, OCR error rates, and teacher feedback from Katni and Indore.

messages.content: What specific issues were observed during the Indore and Katni pre-pilots?

### 🗺️ Granular Findings: Indore & Katni Pre-Pilots

#### **1. Indore (Subhash Nagar MS 108 & Nandbag - 100 Students)**
- **Observer:** Smt. Deepti Khandelwal (DIET Indore).
- **Rapid Upload:** Uploading up to 10 sheets worked smoothly (20-30s per sheet).
- **AI Rigidness Failure:** Question asked for '90 days'; student wrote '3 months'. AI strictly marked it wrong.
- **Vision Crop Drop:** Q1 and Q2 on page 1 were consistently auto-cropped out (only 7 out of 10 questions evaluated).
- **Teacher Feedback:** AI must be positioned as a **Teacher Support Tool**, not a teacher replacement.

#### **2. Katni (EPES Purwar & MS Devri Hatai - 91 Students)**
- **Data Loss Rate:** 59.3% of historical data was purged due to the 200-evaluation database cap.
- **Digit OCR Misreads:** 5.1% error rate on handwritten numbers (e.g., misreading '9996' as '3226').
- **Review Latency:** 208 seconds average review time per paper due to slow manual corrections.
